Open Door App
INTERACTIVE MOBILE APP PROTOTYPE

A little time. A little company.

Open Door lets students share a free window, not their location. Every friend is a door down the hall. When theirs is open, sunlight pours through.

  • Short on time? Tap Sign in, then Try the demo account to skip setup.
  • Open My Door starts a live countdown your circles can see.
  • Heading to… posts a quick plan. Friends answer "I'm in" or "Grab me one."
  • Schedule finds the windows when you and a friend are both free.
  • Friend activity is simulated, so knocks and replies show up a few seconds after you act.
